title: Design System: Portfolio 2026 — Valentina Andrea Camejo

headline.purpose: Section titles, max 16ch, one emphasised word.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono for buttons, nav, tags, indexes.

shadows.name: lift-sm
shadows.purpose: Buttons on hover; stickers at rest (3px).

shadows.name: lift-md
shadows.purpose: Contact cards (paper on ink), Off-Duty controls.

shadows.name: lift-lg
shadows.purpose: Project cards on hover; 10px for lookbook and interview frames.

shadows.name: inset-outline
shadows.purpose: Active pills inside the header without layout shift.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default curve: hero entrance, shadows, tilts, menu slide, state changes.

motion.name: hero-entrance
motion.value: name 0ms/640ms rise 16px · photo 60ms/700ms scale .97 · statement 110ms · proof 190ms · CTAs 250ms · stickers 300/340/370ms stamp, all --ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The page's one authored entrance, once per visit. No other section animates in.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call to action: ink pill with lime mono label; lifts with a pink printed shadow.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action: outlined ink pill that fills lime on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 1em 1.6em; font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; background: transparent; color: #121316; border: 2px solid #121316; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), box-shadow 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 0.25s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #ccff00; transform: translate(-3px, -3px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #121316; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: none; box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7c3aed; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tag & Category Chip
components.description: Mono uppercase pills: outlined tag and ink-filled category chip.
components.css: .ds-tag, .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-tag { padding: 0.35em 0.9em; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #121316; border: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-chip { padding: 0.25em 0.7em; font-size: 0.7rem; background: #121316; color: #fafafc; }

components.name: Language Switcher

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Header nav link: mono uppercase, inverts to ink with lime text on hover/focus.
components.html: AboutProjectsContact

components.css: .ds-card { width: 320px; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); border: 2px solid #121316; border-radius: 28px; transition: box-shadow 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 var(--accent); transform: translate(-2px, -2px); } .ds-card-cover { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35), transparent 50%), var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); border-bottom: 2px solid #121316; } .ds-card-num { position: absolute; top: 14px; left: 16px; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card-glyph { font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif; font-size: 6rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; transform: rotate(-6deg); transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-glyph { transform: rotate(4deg) scale(1.12); } .ds-card-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif; font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-card-sub { margin: 0; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card-link { align-self: flex-start; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; color: #121316; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent); } .ds-card-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7c3aed; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
A single studio with two workbenches. On one side the editorial bench: oversized Syne headlines, stickers, tilted tickers, colour used like fabric swatches pinned to a mood board. On the other the engineering bench: Space Mono labels and controls, 2px ink borders, tidy grids that never break on a 320px phone. The two benches share one floor: cool off-white paper, near-black ink and four loud accents. Neither soul wins; every surface should show both.

The physical language is tactile and brazen. Buttons, cards and badges behave like printed objects: solid 2px ink outlines, hard offset shadows with no blur, and a hover that lifts the object up and to the left so its shadow shows. Motion is springy and quick on objects, and the page has exactly one authored entrance: the hero, once per visit. Sections don't animate in on scroll, and nothing loops except the ticker. Density is generous: sections breathe with up to 160px between them, and type does most of the work.

The system has no gradients, blurred colour blobs, frosted glass or soft coloured glows: the `--gradient-hero` token and `gradient-text` mixin were deleted. The only blurs left are functional (the sticky header and dialog backdrops); the only gradients are the material rendering of the Off-Duty music player and the faint diagonal stripes on lime blocks.
keyCharacteristics: Paper and ink base, four accents rotated per item through a local `--accent` variable.
Syne 800 at poster scale with tight, negative tracking; mono for every label and control.
Hard offset shadows (no blur) as the signature depth cue; pill shapes for controls, large soft corners for containers.
Sections open straight on the headline, with no eyebrow or number; ticker bands tilted ±1–1.5° as section breaks.
Pointer-driven 3D tilt on hero and project cards, disabled on touch and under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Rotating Accent Rule
rules.body: Items in a collection (projects, story chapters, skill groups, outfits, interview entries) each take one accent via `.accent-{violet|pink|lime|sky}`, which sets `--accent` and `--on-accent`. Components read `var(--accent)`; they never hard-code an accent.

rules.name: The Lime-on-Ink Rule
rules.body: Acid Lime carries ink text and ink outlines only. Lime text on paper or white is illegible and forbidden.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Accent Rule
rules.body: Text on an accent fill is ink, except on Electric Violet, which takes white (≈5.7:1). White on Hot Pink (≈3.5:1) or Pool Cyan (≈2.4:1) fails AA and is not used. `.accent-*` sets `--on-accent` accordingly.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Headlines are Syne, controls and metadata are Space Mono, prose is Plus Jakarta Sans. No fourth voice, and never body text in mono or labels in Syne.

rules.name: The One Emphasis Rule
rules.body: A headline highlights exactly one word or short phrase (`<em>`, upright, never italic) in a solid colour. Never a gradient.

rules.name: The Printed Shadow Rule
rules.body: New shadows are solid offsets, down-right, with zero blur, in ink or the item's accent. If it needs a blur radius, it does not belong to this system.

rules.name: The Lift Rule
rules.body: On hover an object translates up-left by the same amount its shadow grows (e.g. −3px/−3px with a 4px shadow) and returns to rest on `:active`.

dos: **Do** give every collection item an accent through `.accent-*` and read `var(--accent)` in the component.
**Do** express elevation with a solid, zero-blur offset shadow in ink or the accent, paired with an equal up-left lift on hover.
**Do** use 2px ink borders for anything the user can grab or click, and pills for every control.
**Do** write labels, buttons and nav in uppercase Space Mono, and headlines in Syne 800 with −0.03em tracking.
**Do** build grids with `minmax(0, 1fr)` and test copy in all three languages at 320px.
**Do** show focus with a 3px Electric Violet outline, gate hover motion behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`, and give every animation a `prefers-reduced-motion` variant.
donts: **Don't** add scroll reveals, hover spotlights or infinite loops (pulses, pings); the hero entrance is the page's one choreographed moment.
**Don't** use blurred colour blobs, gradient text or fills, frosted-glass frames or soft coloured glows.
**Don't** put an eyebrow, kicker or `(0N)` section number above a heading.
**Don't** put lime text on paper or white, or white text on Pool Cyan or Hot Pink.
**Don't** stand Unicode glyphs or emoji in for icons, or present the concept projects as client work.
**Don't** use blurred drop shadows as elevation.
**Don't** introduce a fourth typeface or set prose in mono.
**Don't** hard-code an accent inside a reusable component.
